headSubject: feat(relay): one per-machine setting decides what code a browser AI may add (REG-354): never (default) | pages | all
summary: Closed REG-323/335/347/348/350/351/352 (validator now checks packs; tours use a throw-away webview profile). Built the My parts tab (Manager 0.13.43), Portuguese pack labels from a platform catalogue (228 labels, packs stay English), the always-on language switch, and a per-machine relay code setting never|pages|all (default never, this machine set to all; JS pages done and tested, REG-354 PARTIAL, Java split to REG-355).
nextStep: 1) Ask the owner to say install it (or close the Manager), then run: pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/release/New-ManagerInstaller.ps1 -Install -StopRunning -Launch; the installed copy is still 0.13.39 and the new My parts tab (0.13.43, built at D:/WorkSpace/NPDev/Build/manager-target/release/npdev-manager.exe) is only in the build exe; verify the installed version reads 0.13.43. 2) Prove REG-354 on the real Manager window: with relay.codeFromBrowserAi=all, a change conversation asking for a small JS page must show two required ticks, write web/x.js + browser-ai-code.json, and Undo must remove both. 3) REG-353 remaining: Portuguese server messages (validation, error, batch row messages) and the typed picker default Select label (AutoPanelExpander line ~736 needs a labelKey like the action buttons, plus the client reading it). 4) REG-355 (Java through the hash-pinned extension manifest). Also ask whether to stop the validator service (pid 14472), the ngrok tunnel and SalesTest1 on port 8080, all still running, and delete D:/WorkSpace/NPDev/Build/manager-target/release/npdev-manager.running-0.13.42.exe after the owner closes that window.
blocked: Manager install needs the owner's OK to close their open window; the real-window proof of code ticks and any real chat-AI round need the owner. REG-354 open question is only Java (REG-355), not blocked.
verified: Ran and green: dsl full unit tests and generator full unit tests (after the pack-label and locale changes); NPDevCli relay suite 555 tests with the machine setting really at all; test_relay_codepolicy 18; Manager UI render checker 402/402; check-ui-i18n, check-twin-pair-consistency, check-done-item-guards (0 blocking), check-experience-client 62, check-manager-version-bump, run-portable-tooling-check, check-schema-mirror-consistency; real-exe proofs on a throw-away profile (My parts tab, p5 tour 12/12); SalesTest1 regenerated and read in a Portuguese headless browser (Pedido de venda, pt columns). NOT run: T2 gates, canary, exposure-matrix, run-shell-scenarios and the i18n-pt browser routine after the template edits, a real Manager window check of the code tick boxes, any real chat AI asked for a JS page.
